memory_update.text: SHECY should remain the reference anchor for the semiconductor quartz/crucible/wafer materials node because it discloses quartz crucibles, silicon wafers, quartz glass, photomask substrates, pellicles, and wafer cases.

ENTG is a high-quality but not obscure public candidate for ultra-clean semiconductor materials, filtration, purification, and contamination-control exposure; treat as underfollowed by node rather than by market cap.
ICHR is a low-attention public supplier-to-toolmakers candidate for gas and chemical fluid delivery subsystems; key risk is high customer concentration and semiconductor equipment cyclicality.
AXTI belongs in speculative shadow until primary filings confirm the scale, ownership, and customer qualification of any PBN crucible or raw-material exposure.

Direct public exposure to Spruce Pine high-purity quartz, Momentive Technologies, CoorsTek, and other crucible/material chokepoints appears limited because major assets are private, embedded, or disclosed only at subsidiary level.
For later layers, split this node into four verifiable subnodes: quartz/crucibles, silicon/compound wafers, ultra-clean chemicals/filters, and gas/liquid delivery subsystems.

node: High-purity quartz, crucibles, wafers, and ultra-clean semiconductor materials
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the semiconductor ultra-clean materials node finds that the most direct public-market exposure is often outside the obvious AI-chip universe: Shin-Etsu as the reference leader in silicon wafers/quartz-related semiconductor materials; Entegris as a large but relatively pure contamination-control and high-purity materials supplier; Ichor as an underfollowed fluid-delivery subsystem supplier tied to process-gas and chemical delivery; and AXT as a speculative shadow candidate in compound-semiconductor substrates and related raw-material/crucible inputs. Direct Spruce Pine high-purity quartz assets and several crucible leaders appear private or embedded, so the public-market mapping should track suppliers to wafer, tool, gas, chemical, filtration, and ultra-clean subsystem layers rather than only quartz miners.
